translations.en:
A low-ranking demon.

With no more stamina, strength,
or magical ability than a
novice Mage, imps are easily
exterminated. But weak
demons tend to gather in
packs. Imagine how much pain
a horde of imps could cause
if they all hurled fireballs
at once... and take
precautions accordingly.

translations.en:
Though not particularly large,
its body and wings are perfectly
suited to flying freely through
narrow labyrinths. Its claws can
easily tear through human flesh,
making them a serious threat. It
also possesses the spell resistance
characteristic of demons and
often appears in groups, making
it a dangerous opponent early
in an adventurer's career.

translations.en:
A knight riding a dark horse that
occasionally emerges from the
world of the dead, beheads
adventurers, then departs. This
is a low-ranking demon, and
ordinarily an adventurer with a
reasonable amount of skill should
have little trouble defeating it.

However, groups sometimes
stride through the labyrinth
like an order of knights,
so caution is required.

translations.en:
It appears disguised as various
animals, including cats and
birds. It has a hat that
renders its body invisible, so
it sometimes appears unseen.

By extending its long tongue or
transforming into mist or a
snake, it enters a sleeping
person's body through their mouth
and inflicts terrible agony.

translations.en:
A mid-ranking demon that drains
human vitality, or odic energy,
bringing its victims to death.

This energy-draining ability also
steals the experience and abilities
people have accumulated throughout
their lives. Losing that experience
makes their movements sluggish,
while the loss of odic energy places
their very life force in peril.

translations.en:
A succubus seduces men
with her exquisite
appearance, breath,
gaze, and lewd whispers.

She possesses a special ability
called Energy Drain, which steals
both a person's vitality and all
their experience. In addition to
the spell resistance characteristic
of demons, she can wield a
certain range of spells herself.

translations.en:
When a huge red fireball appears
in the labyrinth, a Lesser
Demon will likely materialize
a moment later. Experienced
adventurers can exterminate
these creatures easily, provided
they prevent their numbers
from growing. They also often
appear alongside the pale
blue fireballs that bring
Greater Demons into being.

translations.en:
A demon of this rank remains
an unparalleled threat to
humanity even with most of
its abilities sealed away.

It can cast spells and has
strong spell resistance, making
magic less effective against it.
Even in physical combat, only
adventurers hardened by
countless battles can hope to
leave so much as a scratch.
translations.note: Meaning review: source says spells have difficulty affecting it, not that it is immune to magic.

translations.en:
An opponent that demands vigilance
not only from seasoned adventurers,
but even from class masters.
Its powerful spell resistance
and relentless barrage of
high-level attack spells alone
guarantee a difficult fight. Its
skin, harder than steel, halves
the force of most attacks, and
a single blow from its sharp
claws can cause paralysis.

translations.en:
Before adventurers, Baphomet
assumes the form of a beautiful
man capable of charming even
other men. Only after enchanting
them does it reveal its true
form. The enormous scythe in
its hand can easily sever the
head of even a powerful man,
yet every severed head retains
an expression of ecstasy.

translations.en:
One of the highest-ranking demons,
ordinarily a being equal to a
god. However, the seal called
the Prison of the Old Ones
restrains it, allowing adventurers
trained to the utmost limits to
defeat it. Besides waves of
sword strikes and spells unleashed
by its four arms, it possesses
the spell resistance
characteristic of demons and a
variety of special abilities.

translations.en:
A goblin brought back to
life through sorcery.

Unlike a zombie, it
retains a measure of
awareness and attacks
with weapons.

Until their bodies rot away
completely, these creatures make
excellent sentries. Their putrid
stench can supposedly be detected
from far away in the labyrinth.

translations.en:
A monster created when a dead
kobold becomes a zombie.

Its former fighting instincts
lead it to carry a weapon,
but it is more likely to
bite or grapple with its
enemies than to swing it.

It never flees or concerns itself
with its body's limits, attacking
relentlessly. Novices will
find it a formidable opponent.

translations.en:
If you see drifting,
pale blue smoke giving
off a faint glow... it
is probably Grave Mist.

Said to be the souls of
the buried dead, these
spirits may once have been
renowned adventurers...

Perhaps clinging to an obsession
from life, they often attack
fellow adventurers in an
attempt to possess them.

translations.en:
The remains of an adventurer
who fell in the labyrinth.
A specter has possessed
the corpse, or an evil
mage has resurrected
it as a monster.

Like zombies, skeletons no longer
feel human pain. Their joints
have an even wider range of
movement than a zombie's, allowing
them to launch strange attacks
that cannot be anticipated.

translations.en:
Zombies devour the bodies,
brains, and entrails of the
living, trying to infect
their victims and turn them
into more of their kind.
Their rotting bodies become
immobile within three months
at most. However, labyrinths
never lack fresh corpses,
so their zombie
populations never die out.

translations.en:
It hunts humans, flying silently
toward their throats and devouring
flesh and bone alike. Its
enormous, sharp fangs seem almost
too large for its mouth to close.
It constantly drinks its prey's
blood and circulates it throughout
its wings before taking flight.
If deprived of blood for a
long period, its wings
apparently lose their firmness,
leaving it unable to fly.

translations.en:
Vampires reign at the pinnacle
of the undead that exist
in this world. Unlike other
undead, they possess great
intelligence and a distinctive
culture. Their abilities
include spells, Energy
Drain, spell resistance,
special attacks that cause
paralysis and other
ailments, and astonishing
powers of regeneration.

translations.en:
Though it resembles a spider,
this is an undead spirit.
Its abdomen holds a mass of
young spiders, each the size
of a thumb. Mother and
offspring attack together,
seeking vitality, flesh, and
blood. These young spiders
serve as a kind of feeding
organ for the main body.

It also possesses a powerful
Energy Drain ability.

translations.en:
Shades are beings that dwell
in darkness, their true bodies
sealed within the Prison of the
Old Ones. The shades that appear
are something like spiritual
projections. They seem to
drain adventurers' life force
and send it back to their
true bodies behind the seal.

translations.en:
It is said that a banshee's
blazing red eyes weep
for those about to die.
Apparently once a kind
of fairy, she is now
classed among the undead,
perhaps because of her
habit of calling the
dead. Being touched by
one of these beings
causes Energy Drain.

translations.en:
A mummy's hardened bandages
can withstand a sword blow.
Its body is better preserved
than a zombie's, granting
it considerable strength.
It moves faster than an
inferior zombie and sometimes
uses Energy Drain against
the living. Mummies are not
particularly numerous, so
encounters with them are
rare even in the labyrinth.

translations.en:
A stone statue that roams the labyrinth.

These statues have no heads.
They wander through the labyrinth
looking for human heads to
attach to their own bodies.

Some adventurers have been attacked
during their travels and lost
their heads to these creatures.

translations.en:
An enormous zombie created
by stitching together countless
human corpses. One blow from
its massive arm crumples
an iron shield like a scrap
of paper. However fine the
armor, the body inside
bursts like a water balloon.
Its foul, deadly poisonous
breath is powerful enough
to wipe out an entire
party in an instant.

translations.en:
A dragon revived through
forbidden resurrection magic.
In addition to its spellcasting
ability, it attacks beyond
its body's natural limits
and breathes a deadly poison
that rots anything it
touches. Becoming undead
has made it extraordinarily
formidable. It habitually
kills adventurers and embeds
them in its own body to
replace missing parts.

translations.en:
Also known as a wight. Its true
body lies sealed within the
Prison of the Old Ones. It
possesses the corpses of royalty
and other noble people, using
them to interfere in this world.
It casts both Mage and Priest
spells and also unleashes a
devastating Energy Drain.
